money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The US Dollar is the legal currency of Ecuador. It's useful to have $US1 notes. Many smaller shops and taxi drivers don't change large notes. laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe and include long prison terms in local jails. Minimum sentence for trafficking or consuming 'soft drugs', such as marijuana (cannabis), can be 1 to 2 years in jail. - Carrying or using drugs

laws.rule: You must always carry photo identification in Ecuador. Authorities may detain you if you don't.

laws.rule: Political activity by foreigners is illegal. This includes joining protests or demonstrations. If you participate, authorities may detain or deport you.

drone-pilot-pathway.summary: Ecuador's DGAC classes drone use under RDAC 101: Open for personal recreation up to 4 kg; Specific for aerial work or private aerial services up to 250 kg. Foreign-operator and register details were not found.

items.text: No public register of drone operators was found on the DGAC pages read. The drone section has a 'Registro de drones' page that was not read in full.

Under RDAC 101 the Open category covers only personal recreational flights (up to 4 kg). Professional, commercial or for-profit flights, private aerial services and aerial work fall in the Specific category (up to 250 kg). DGAC's general Permiso de Operacion covers aerial work and related activities; the page read does not say how it applies to drones.
Not yet checked: the pages read do not mention foreign visitors.
